proposed_core_edits.reason: The revised proof directly uses the frozen weighted-support reduction and Rado independent-transversal lemma, so those load-bearing dependencies are added explicitly.

proposed.justification: This reduction checks that the support theorem contains the banked rectangular result rather than replacing it with an unrelated analogue.
proposed.gap: The prior proposal proves only this symmetric full-support boundary and explicitly leaves heterogeneous alphabets and structural zeros unresolved.
proposed.consumer: Existing full-support applications retain their arithmetic diagnostic, while sparse-support applications gain the strictly finer Hall certificate.
